verdict.rationale: Bento ships a CLI (50+ commands) and an HTTP API with Basic auth plus first-party SDKs, all of which are scriptable and could be run headlessly/in CI, and docs even mention 'script the job you run every week.' However there's no explicit CI/automation documentation, pipeline examples, or GitHub Actions integration shown. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless-mode documentation, example automation pipeline, non-interactive auth/token flow guidance for CI environments.
